paper.title: Algorithm 706: DCUTRI, an algorithm for adaptive cubature over a collection of triangles

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 706 archive 706.gz: one listing file 706.txt, 4415 lines, holding DCUTRI and its routines plus several sample PROGRAM units)

claim.text: Live sample PROGRAM DTEST1 (archive line 1367) run unedited on the TOMS 706 sample integrand exp(x^2+y^2) over triangle (0,0),(2,0),(0,2), EPSREL=1e-5, MAXPTS=2000, prints RESULT=11.181284417019 (tol 1e-9), NEVAL=185 and IFAIL=0 (exact). Registered by scout 73030b9 (artifact-reference).

attempt: Built the authors' single source file (706.gz, sha256 c67596047b71b0642323a2593ceea4949d5782cc4df6518efcdfb05ed8fc97bc) as listed: the file holds two PROGRAM units (DTEST1 and the driver of the listing), so it does not compile as one unit (Error: Two main PROGRAMs, evidence/original-attempt build log). The patch copies eight subprograms verbatim from six non-contiguous line ranges (evidence/extract.txt, impl/extract.py). Our RESULT 11.181284417019187 agrees with the registered 11.181284417019 (diff 1.9e-13, tol 1e-9), NEVAL 185 and IFAIL 0 exact. Blocked, not reproduced: the multi-range extraction is a source patch under docs/method.md ('Extraction covers one verbatim range'), so G2 needs a paper check that cannot be done because the paper is not accessible. Operator decision (DM #148): keep blocked; gates.py is not changed.

original_attempt.reason: The listing as shipped, compiled as one unit with gfortran -std=legacy, does not compile: 'Error: Two main PROGRAMs at (1) and (2)'. No build file ships with the archive. The attempt is kept in the log.

patch.note: Subprograms copied verbatim from several non-contiguous listing ranges (see evidence/extract.txt). Not covered by the build-only or single-range extraction checks; G2 is not met by a mechanical check.

blocked_on.missing: paper check for the multi-range extraction (paper not accessible)
